// Exact public GoAI capability and wrapper from parent74a7c5c923b25aa35773bb9e907b76aba04a553a.
// Unchanged at PR1210 merge ec20269a20e2028ec10aa02cd9d26095e8aa161b.
// https://github.com/jxsl13/goai/blob/74a7c5c923b25aa35773bb9e907b76aba04a553a/llamagpu/decoder.go
type binaryNRecorder interface {
	BinaryN(a, b, o buffer, op, n int) error
}

func (d *Decoder) binElem(r recorder, a, b, o buffer, op, rows, width int) error {
	if bn, ok := r.(binaryNRecorder); ok && rows > 0 && width > 0 {
		return bn.BinaryN(a, b, o, op, rows*width)
	}
	return r.Binary(a, b, o, op)
}
